title: 第13章 和狼还挺有缘的第14章 也不是战斗型伙伴啊
slug: 是攻略系统不是攻城略地系统
content_zh:
直到傍晚时分，天空之上明月显现。
月华照耀在身上，“月之子”特质生效，李凯南身体的各方面属性都得到了不小的增幅。
李凯南全副武装，左侧腰间配剑，右侧腰间挂着战斧、骑士锤，胯下骏马两侧挂着猎弓和箭矢，开始启程前往被诅咒的城堡！
布兰妮原本也打算跟着一块儿过去的，她如今已经正式踏上女巫之路，身上还有不少外婆交给她防身用的魔法道具，确实可以帮到李凯南。
但为了稳妥起见，李凯南还是将布兰妮留在了小镇之上。
城堡那边的情况还不算太清楚，李凯南一个人行动会更加方便一点。
假如怪物太厉害打不过，他跑起来也更容易一些……
……
莫里斯在白天逃出来的时候，就已经打算带着人回来救自己的女儿，所以一路上都留下了明显的标记。
根据他留下的标记，李凯南顺利地进入了森林之中。
一开始的时候并没有什么异常，眼前这片外人不敢进入的森林也没有外界传得那么玄乎。
不过随着越发深入，森林之中的温度却开始诡异地下降。
进入到这片森林深处的时候，天空之上甚至有雪花飘落。
周遭草木尽数凋敝，光秃秃的枯木造型扭曲诡异，甚至还动不动就看到被啃食干净的白骨散落在四周，就好似忽然进入到某处生命禁区！
走到这里，身下骑着的骏马已经越发不安了起来。
似乎是感知到了什么危险，它甚至不愿继续前进。
李凯南双眼一眯，然后忽然伸手取下了自己挂一旁的猎弓，对准了前方就是一箭射出。
因为此前亲眼见识过李凯南到底拥有何等恐怖的力量，老猎人送来的猎弓都是特制的。
大尺寸、大弓稍的重型猎弓，就连箭矢也是那种箭身粗，箭镞宽，一箭能将猎物直接钉在地上的重箭！
李凯南射出的重箭卷起呼啸破空之声，那两头白狼连惨叫都没有发出来，便被直接串在一起死死钉在了地上！

而随着这一箭射出，旁边的枯木林之中顿时响起了纷乱的动静。
一声又一声的狼嚎忽然响起，一双又一双冒着渗人绿光的眼睛从暗处出现。
李凯南胯下的马匹开始不住地嘶鸣起来，四蹄不安地刨起地来想要往后退。
李凯南死死勒着缰绳驾驭着，眉头微微挑动。
咦，自己和狼还挺有缘的啊？
穿越过来还没两天呢，居然遇到了这么多的狼……
李凯南神色淡定地环顾四周，然后一眼就盯上了前方山丘上那头身形最为壮硕，站在高处俯瞰局势的白狼。
嗯，头狼！
李凯南找到了目标，又淡定地举起手中重弓，对准那头白狼又是一箭射出。
远处山丘之上的白色头狼此时敏锐地察觉到了危险，浑身毛发炸开想要躲开。
但下一刻只听得呼啸破空之声在耳边尖啸响起，白色头狼甚至来不及反应，巨大身躯便被重箭贯穿！
头狼临死之前的凄厉哀嚎声，瞬间让周遭狼群开始混乱起来。
content_en:
Until evening, the bright moon appears in the sky.
The moonlight shines on his body, and the "Moon Son" trait takes effect, and all aspects of Li Kainan's body attributes have increased significantly.
Li Kainan was fully armed, with a sword on his left waist, a battle ax and a knight's hammer on his right waist, and a hunting bow and arrows on both sides of his horse. He set off for the cursed castle!
Britney originally planned to go with her. Now she has officially embarked on the journey of being a witch. She also has many magic props given to her by her grandmother for self-defense, which can indeed help Li Kainan.
But to be on the safe side, Li Kainan still left Britney in the town.
The situation at the castle is not too clear yet, and it would be more convenient for Li Kainan to move alone.
If the monster is too powerful to defeat, it will be easier for him to run...
…
When Morris escaped during the day, he had already planned to bring people back to rescue his daughter, so he left obvious marks along the way.
According to the marks he left, Li Kainan successfully entered the forest.
There was nothing unusual at the beginning, and the forest in front of me, which outsiders did not dare to enter, was not as mysterious as the outside world said.
However, as we went deeper and deeper, the temperature in the forest began to drop strangely.
When we entered the depths of this forest, there were even snowflakes falling from the sky.
The surrounding vegetation is all withered, the bare dead trees are twisted and weird, and you can even see gnawed bones scattered around, as if you have suddenly entered a restricted area of ​​life!
When we got here, the horse riding under him became more and more uneasy.
It seemed that it sensed some danger and was unwilling to move forward.
Li Kainan narrowed his eyes, then suddenly reached out and took down the hunting bow hanging by his side, pointed it forward and shot an arrow.
Because he had seen with his own eyes how terrifying power Li Kainan possessed, the hunting bows sent by the old hunter were all specially made.
A heavy hunting bow with a large size and a large bow. Even the arrows are heavy with thick arrow bodies and wide arrowheads. One arrow can pin the prey directly to the ground!
The heavy arrow fired by Li Kainan made a roaring sound through the air. The two white wolves didn't even scream, but were strung together and nailed to the ground!
And as the arrow was shot, chaotic movements suddenly sounded in the dead wood forest nearby.
Wolf howls suddenly sounded out one after another, and pairs of eyes with oozing green light appeared from the darkness.
The horse under Li Kainan began to neigh incessantly, and its hooves scratched the ground uneasily, trying to retreat.
Li Kainan tightly tightened the reins and steered, his brows slightly raised.
Hey, you and the wolf are quite close, right?
It’s only been two days since I traveled across time, and I’ve actually encountered so many wolves…
Li Kainan looked around calmly, and then immediately fixed his eyes on the strongest white wolf on the hill in front, standing on a high place overlooking the situation.
Well, alpha wolf!
Li Kainan found the target, calmly raised the heavy bow in his hand, aimed at the white wolf and shot another arrow.
The white wolf on the distant hill was keenly aware of the danger, and the hair on its body exploded in an attempt to avoid it.
But the next moment, only the sound of roaring through the air was heard screaming in the ears. The white wolf didn't even have time to react, and his huge body was pierced by a heavy arrow!
The screams of the alpha wolf before his death instantly caused the surrounding wolves to become confused.
